subject: RM_Verdimoss
departures: grows in beaded lines: strings of separate rounded cushions running along cracks, not a continuous green carpet
blue-green colour, not the yellow-green or forest-green of Earth moss
where it grows over metal it turns the colour of oxidised bronze (a verdigris-teal patina), so it reads as part of the metal surface
follows seep cracks in the ground as narrow linear tracks
drapes over and half-covers old machine relics, so the shape of the machine still shows under the moss
